text: Which kidney-specific genes show moderate or strong staining in the glomeruli?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Kidney / Tissue enriched AND Tissue expression (IHC): Kidney / cells in glomeruli / Medium, High
understanding: The user seeks genes categorized as tissue-specific (or enriched) for kidney (RNA specificity) that also display moderate (medium) or strong (high) immunohistochemical staining in glomeruli cells of the kidney.

trail.why: In the Human Protein Atlas, tissue-specific genes correspond strictly to the 'Tissue enriched' category, representing at least a four-fold higher mRNA level in kidney compared to any other tissue.

trail.requirement: moderate or strong staining in the glomeruli
trail.why: Selects kidney as the tissue, cells in glomeruli as the cell type, and Medium and High to capture moderate or strong IHC staining.

requirements.why: This field defines RNA tissue specificity and distribution across tissue types, including kidney specificity categories.

requirements.requirement: moderate or strong staining in the glomeruli
requirements.why: This field captures antibody staining (IHC) per tissue, specific cell type (glomeruli), and expression level (Medium, High).
